metadata.title: Tesla Is Ready to Launch Its EV Semi Truck—and the Stock Is Rising<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Tesla Is Ready to Launch Its EV Semi Truck—and the Stock Is Rising
Tesla stock rose early Friday, trying to close out a solid week on a high note. An electric vehicle is helping, which is a surprise for the EV maker these days.
